source: airports: OurAirports (https://ourairports.com), public domain. tz: IANA zone names from OpenFlights (https://openflights.org/data, ODbL), joined by ICAO code and falling back to IATA; airports in neither were given the zone of the three nearest sourced airports within 300 km when all three agreed, and left empty otherwise. A zone whose UTC offset disagreed with the airport's longitude by more than 3.5 h was rejected rather than trusted.
